event: Nala takes Counter Keeping down from its low shelf near the Counter.
She rolls a ladder along its brass rail to the west gallery and climbs.

memory.fact: Rolling ladders on brass rails reach the high shelves and the gallery above.

event: High on the west gallery she finds Courtesies of the Many Peoples and carries it down.
She sits on the step of the Counter's platform with both books, and opens Courtesies first.
At her pace its first part, on the commonest peoples, takes a quarter hour.

memory.fact: Courtesies' first part covers the commonest patrons: elves, satyrs, Bectiwode and Aracnio.

event: She opens Counter Keeping, a working text of the Library's own magic, dense and exact.
For some three hours she works through it page by page, as she did Shelf Sight.
She follows every word, but the power in it never unfolds; nothing settles behind her eyes.
She reaches the last page, and no window opens.

memory.fact: Nala read Counter Keeping through in some three hours, but its power did not take.

event: Links: it hasn't taken. It won't, until she has learned something new.

event: Links: another power, from another book; then Counter Keeping may give way to her.
